an8.73:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nādike viharati giñjakāvasathe.
an8.73:1.6: maraṇasati bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānā.
an8.73:2.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.73:2.3: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇasatinti?
an8.73:2.5: ahovatāhaṃ rattindivaṃ jīveyyaṃ, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti.
an8.73:2.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, bhāvemi maraṇasatinti.
an8.73:3.3: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatinti?
an8.73:3.5: aho vatāhaṃ divasaṃ jīveyyaṃ bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti.
an8.73:3.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, bhāvemi maraṇasatinti.
an8.73:4.3: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatinti?
an8.73:4.5: aho vatāhaṃ upaḍḍhadivasaṃ jīveyyaṃ bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti.
an8.73:4.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, bhāvemi maraṇasatinti.
an8.73:5.3: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatinti?
an8.73:5.5: ahovatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti.
an8.73:5.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, bhāvemi maraṇasatinti.
an8.73:6.3: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatinti. ?
an8.73:6.5: ahovatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ upaḍḍhapiṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti.
an8.73:6.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatinti.
an8.73:7.3: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatinti?
an8.73:7.5: aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ, yadantaraṃ cattāro pañca ālope saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi. bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti.
an8.73:7.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, bhāvemi maraṇasatinti.
an8.73:8.3: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatinti?
an8.73:8.5: aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ, yadantaraṃ ekaṃ ālopaṃ saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi. bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti.
an8.73:8.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, bhāvemi maraṇasatinti.
an8.73:9.3: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatinti?
an8.73:9.5: aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ, yadantaraṃ assasitvā vā passasāmi, passasitvā vā assasāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti.
an8.73:9.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, bhāvemi maraṇasatinti.
an8.73:10.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā te bhikkhu etadavoca:
an8.73:10.2: yvāyaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti:
an8.73:10.3: aho vatāhaṃ rattindivaṃ jīveyyaṃ bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti,
an8.73:10.4: yopāyaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti:
an8.73:10.5: aho vatāhaṃ divasaṃ jīveyyaṃ bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti.
an8.73:10.6: yopāyaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti.
an8.73:10.7: ahovatāhaṃ upaḍḍhadivasaṃ jīveyyaṃ, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti,
an8.73:10.8: yopāyaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti:
an8.73:10.9: aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti.
an8.73:10.10: yopāyaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti:
an8.73:10.11: aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ, yadantaraṃ upaḍḍhapiṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti,
an8.73:10.12: yopāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti:
an8.73:10.13: aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ cattāro vā pañca ālope saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti,
an8.73:10.14: ime vuccanti bhikkhave bhikkhu pamattā viharanti dandhaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāventi āsavānaṃ khayāya:
an8.73:11.1: yo ca khvāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti;
an8.73:11.2: aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekaṃ ālopaṃ saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti,
an8.73:11.4: aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ, yadantaraṃ assasitvā passasāmī ca passasitvā vā assasāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti,
an8.73:11.5: ime vuccanti bhikkhave bhikkhu appamattā viharanti tikkhaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāventi āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an8.73:12.2: appamattā viharissāma, tikkhaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveyyāma āsavānaṃ khayāyāti.
